require 'net/http'
require 'json'

API_KEY = ENV.fetch("BUTTONDOWN_API_KEY")
BASE = "https://api.buttondown.com/v1/events"
EVENT_TYPES = ["clicked", "opened", "complained"]

def aggregate_events(email_id)
  EVENT_TYPES.each_with_object({}) do |event_type, counts|
    uri = URI(BASE)
    uri.query = URI.encode_www_form(email_id: email_id, event_type: event_type)

    request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri)
    request["Authorization"] = "Token #{API_KEY}"

    response = Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) do |http|
      http.request(request)
    end

    counts[event_type] = JSON.parse(response.body)["count"]
  end
end

aggregate_events("EMAIL_ID").each do |event_type, total|
  puts "#{event_type}: #{total}"
end
